info.name: Prime Locker - Agreement & DLT SMS API

Manually triggers a device unlock command and restores active status.

item.name: 8. Apple MDM (iPhone Locker - Loksiz)
item.description: Comprehensive integration with Loksiz Apple MDM v1.4 for iPhone supervised management, eligibility validation, enrollment, remote lock/unlock, kiosk mode, activation lock, wallpaper, GPS tracking, and real-time webhook status callbacks.

request.description: Checks connectivity with Loksiz Apple MDM Gateway (returns 200 OK with health status).
Validates iPhone IMEI & Serial Number eligibility and verifies available IOS key balance in the Loksiz partner wallet before registration.
Registers Apple device with Loksiz MDM, generates deviceRegNum, and creates or updates local Device record with APPLE_MDM lock provider.

item.name: 8.4 List Registered Apple Devices & Dashboard Counters

request.description: Fetches all enrolled iOS devices and dashboard summary (total, active, pending, inactive) directly from Loksiz.

item.name: 8.5 Remote Lock iPhone (Lost Mode with Custom Message & Phone)

request.description: Executes immediate Lost Mode LOCK on the managed iPhone, displaying custom overdue message, call button phone number, and footnote.
Instantly removes Lost Mode lock from the iPhone, restoring normal customer access.

item.name: 8.7 Standard Remote Lock (Auto-routes to Apple MDM)

request.description: Standard Prime Locker lock endpoint. Automatically dispatches lock to Loksiz Apple MDM when device is an iPhone / APPLE_MDM.

item.name: 8.8 Standard Remote Unlock (Auto-routes to Apple MDM)

request.description: Standard Prime Locker unlock endpoint. Automatically dispatches unlock to Loksiz Apple MDM.
Enforces Single App Mode / Kiosk mode on the managed iPhone.
Removes application lock restriction, returning device to normal multi-app operation.
Triggers Apple MDM Activation Lock. Action 1 = Enable, 0 = Disable.
Queries the current Activation Lock status of the iPhone.
Sets custom branded wallpaper on iPhone Lock Screen and Home Screen.
Removes custom wallpaper and restores system default wallpaper on iPhone.
Dispatches instant GET_LOCATION command to retrieve current iPhone coordinates.

item.name: 8.16 Release / Uninstall MDM Profile (Post EMI Settlement)

request.description: Deregisters iPhone from Apple MDM and marks device as UNENROLLED in Prime Locker.
Simulates real-time webhook callback dispatched by Loksiz MDM when device is locked/unlocked. Returns HTTP 200 within 10s.
Simulates real-time webhook callback dispatched by Loksiz MDM containing device GPS coordinates.

Returns retailer's live digital wallet balance, total collected gross, total withdrawn, 2% platform fee paid, registered bank details, and recent ledger entries.

Real-time analytics dashboard reporting total 2% platform revenue (today, this month, this year, all-time), gross EMI volumes, online vs offline split, and wallet liability balances.
